title: A genuine quadratic attains the constant-step worst-case distance envelope
target_statement: For 0<alpha<=beta and every real h, choose mu in {alpha,beta}. The actual scalar quadratic is C2, alpha-strongly convex, beta-smooth and minimized at0; starting at1 its N-step norm equals max(|1-halpha|,|1-hbeta|)^N >= q^N for all N, and the balanced-step norm equals q^N. Bounds alpha,beta need not be tight for this scalar witness.
